about.title:
ABOUT EG1

A personal hobby platform for open-source and creative digital
projects, featuring practical engineering software/tools, interactive web
applications and technical articles.
about.content0:
This features two main sections: a Blog, with tutorials and write-ups on technology, and an Apps section, with projects built and maintained as part of EG1 — including webapps and app tools/libraries for learning and real-world use.

With an open-source-first approach, projects here are built with a focus on simplicity, functionality, and open access for anyone who wants to learn or contribute. Whether you're here to read, explore, or use the tools, this is a space for curious minds who enjoy building, tinkering things from the ground up.
about.content:
This website is a personal space for creating and sharing helpful, open-source digital projects built for real-world use.

It features two main sections: an Apps section, showcasing custom webapps, and software/tools made for practical application; and a Blog section, featuring technical articles, tutorials, and engineering write-ups. Driven by an open-source approach, everything here is built with simplicity, functionality, and open access for curious minds who love building and tinkering from the ground up.
